name: How long does a stucco application typically take for a residential home?

mainEntity.name: How long does a stucco application typically take for a residential home?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a stucco application project for a residential home depends on several factors, including the size of the house, the complexity of the architectural details, weather conditions, and the type of stucco system being installed. Generally, a complete stucco application, from prep work to final curing, can take anywhere from one to three weeks. This timeframe ensures proper drying between coats, which is crucial for the stucco's strength and longevity. Our team can provide a more precise timeline after assessing your specific home.
acceptedAnswer.description: Stucco application for a home typically takes one to three weeks, depending on house size, complexity, and weather, allowing for proper drying between coats.
